artifacts.summary: Eight-phase plan landing HitPresented on fixture model A as a wired sorry-free probe (library statement, fixture classification, splice identification, truncation bound, L+6-state presentation, run characterization, assembly, wiring/pins/docs), with the computable bound recorded as blocked via the axiom foot plus a stated-not-proved effective-saturation obligation.

memory_candidates.content: When a formal-proof plan has exactly one link the research could not compile, split that link into a data phase (definitions, tables, step relations) and a proof phase (the characterization over those definitions) rather than one phase. The data phase lands green and committed, so a block on the proof phase leaves the construction's vocabulary in the tree instead of nothing, and the blocked escalation has a concrete goal state to report from. This also makes the plan's own rollback story honest: the phases before the risky one are independently true and useful, which is what lets a [BLOCKED] verdict be a partial success rather than a wasted dispatch.
